title: Ep1 stick v3 sample
logline: Three excerpts rebuilt with the v3 changes: arrivals and aftermaths, Mas's inner voice, varied music, no pointers.

_edits.why: arrival: the bullpen room tone under the button before anything happens
arrival, and the introduction the plates did: who wants what, in his read

_edits.what: J-cut: "Okay, the build's green." starts 0.5 s under the wide
_edits.why: sound leads us into the conversation

_edits.what: V.O. v3s-01b "she'll go for three." after Rima's "Twice."
_edits.why: a read that the picture pays off in 5.07 (her third underline)

_edits.what: V.O. v3s-02 between Rima's question and "it's a preview."
_edits.why: the honest thought, then the public line; the gap is never explained

_edits.what: new held beat on Alyi (the 5.05 frame) with V.O. v3s-03
_edits.why: warmth for Alyi, and the trust Act Four breaks

_edits.what: +1.5 s after "let's see if anyone notices."
_edits.why: aftermath: the two of them and the quiet button

_edits.what: V.O. v3s-04 after Gerg's "It likes everyone…"
_edits.why: he wants to be liked, and says so only to himself

_edits.what: V.O. "nobody noticed." -> "someone noticed."
_edits.why: present tense, in the moment: wonder, not a caught line

_edits.what: cut (v3-plan C5)
_edits.why: the drill repeats; the size reads in half the time

_edits.what: J-cut: Rima's line starts 0.6 s under the held tile
_edits.why: her voice pulls us back up to his face

_edits.what: V.O. v3s-06 "mostly the bill." after "it's the bill.", held 1.8 s
_edits.why: the gap between what he says and what he means; plants "mostly." (S5.05)
arrival: the suite, the Strip, the race weekend (answers the newcomer's "why Vegas?" with picture and sound)

_edits.what: V.O. v3s-07 "alyi set it up. probably just the budget." before JOIN
_edits.why: the one read he gets wrong, after we have just seen the board's plan: suspense by dramatic irony. Then silence inside him for the whole blow

_edits.what: 2.2 -> 4.6 s after "super."
_edits.why: aftermath of the act's biggest turn: the frozen tiles, the room, no score

_edits.what: cut: the WHAT THEY DIDN'T KNOW card
_edits.why: a pointer; his voice returning tells us we are back with him
arrival: the dark room at 2 AM, glass and lanyard

_edits.what: V.O. v3s-08, the hearts counted, then miscounted
_edits.why: the rhythm carries what he won't say: he loses count

_edits.what: V.O. v3s-09 "gerg. he'll say he's compiling." as the tile rings
_edits.why: a read the next line pays off; warmth

_edits.what: 3.5 -> 6.0 s after "He did both."
_edits.why: silence inside him: the held face and the room

_edits.what: V.O. v3s-10 "gerg never waits to be asked." after "Just in case."
_edits.why: the bible's planted line, now in present tense

_edits.what: 2.9 -> 5.5 s after "leave it open."
_edits.why: aftermath: the door ajar

beats.caption: Reviewer slate: 1 / 3 · LAUNCH NIGHT
cues: reviewer-only slate between excerpts (not part of the show)

beats.frame: INSERT · the beige button
beats.caption: A small beige button where the 1993 OK sat. Its 7 px label: research preview.
cues: cut: HARD CUT on the downbeat, out of the card
sound: the bullpen bed (server hum up through the floor, one buzzing tube, Gerg's keys) · music: none under the talk

beats.frame: WIDE · the bullpen after hours (the home room's one wide)
beats.caption: The bullpen after hours, held: the room and the three people in it before anyone speaks.

lines.text: gerg wants to ship it. rima wants it quiet. alyi wants to know what it is first.

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · Mas and Gerg, desk to desk (held)
beats.caption: Gerg ships before anyone agrees. Rima, from the whiteboard, not turning round. Gerg: nobody reads research.

lines.text: Okay, the build's green. I'm shipping it.
We said low-key, Gerg. I underlined it. Twice.
It's a research preview, Rima. Nobody reads research. We'll get forty users and a nice thread.
she'll go for three.

beats.frame: OTS · over Mas onto Rima (held through the bargain)
beats.caption: Rima bargains (one post, a banner), Gerg waves it off; she asks Mas what it costs. "it's a preview."

lines.text: Then let's treat it like one. One little post, no press. And a banner that says it makes things up.
It'll have a banner. Nobody reads banners either.
Mas, it's your call. If it breaks in front of people, and it will, what do we tell them?
it's a preview.
Okay. Say it works. Say people actually use it. That's going to cost us a fortune.
That's a v2 problem.
she's right. it will break. i don't know which part yet.

beats.frame: MCU·glass · Alyi in the doorway, seen in its glass (the cut on the turn)
beats.caption: A new voice from the doorway turns cost into dread: "And what if it wakes up?"

lines.text: And what if it wakes up?

beats.frame: MCU · Rima turns to Mas and waits (1 beat, hers)
beats.caption: She turns from the glass to Mas and waits. His answer lands on her face.

lines.text: …still a preview.

beats.frame: MCU·glass · Alyi in the doorway, seen in its glass (the cut on the turn)
beats.caption: Back on Alyi in the glass, held, while Mas thinks about him. Alyi keeps watching the button.

lines.text: alyi asks that about everything we build. he means it every time.

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · Mas and Gerg (Rima back at the board)
beats.caption: One key, a flourish: "Your button." Behind him Rima underlines LOW-KEY a third time. No line.

lines.text: It's all staged on my end. Your button.

cues: sfx: one key, with a flourish · then the marker squeaks: a third underline

beats.frame: INSERT · his finger on the button
beats.caption: His finger, no hover. Click. Nothing happens.
cues: sfx: click (on 1.0 s), the 1993 OK's click · nothing happens · the band dims back into cutscene mode

beats.frame: MCU·glass · Mas soft in the fg; Rima at the board; Alyi in the doorway (glass)
beats.caption: Alyi, low, to Mas only: the years they share. "you counted." "Someone should." He walks off.

lines.text: Six years and eleven months. From the day we started to that click.
you counted.
Someone should.
let's see if anyone notices.

cues: sound: Gerg's keys under the shot; Rima, at the board, doesn't hear it
sound: Alyi's footsteps go off down the hall after "Someone should."; the glass is empty

beats.frame: OTS · over Mas onto his laptop (the chat's one setup)
beats.caption: "Autocomplete." The bubble lights before anyone types, and flatters. He types one line. It flatters him.

lines.text: So we've launched autocomplete.
Autocomplete that read the internet, Rima. All of it.
What a great question!
Nobody asked one.
Brilliant! You're clearly a visionary.

beats.frame: MCU · Mas, lit from below (his one close shot here)
beats.caption: "it likes me." Gerg, off, not looking: it likes everyone.

lines.text: it likes me.
It likes everyone. It called my variable names inspired.
i know. i still read it twice.

beats.frame: INSERT · the bubble: the counter ticks
beats.caption: A second user arrives. Then a hundred. The 0 ticks over, and the digits blur.
cues: music: MM-16 Odometer (temp pad) comes in on the counter's first tick (0.5 s)

beats.frame: ECU → WIDE · the counter grows (phrase 1, bars 1-2)
beats.caption: The counter detaches and grows into a desk-sized odometer, spinning. V.O. on bar 2.

lines.text: someone noticed.

seq.place: the odometer drill: down through the building

cues: music: MM-16, one performance, 14 bars (4·3·4·3) · thins to bass + brushes under the posts, ducks under the V.O.
sfx: odometer_ratchet, chip notes on F, varied rhythm and pitch (never even beeps)
style (proposed, drastic tier): the descent as a low-poly 3D cutaway of the building · default BASE

beats.frame: WIDE · the drop through the desk (bars 3-4)
beats.caption: On the downbeat it drops through the desk with a clunk. The picture shows the size.
cues: sfx: a whole-pixel CLUNK on the downbeat (0.0 s)

beats.frame: INSERT · cut up: Gerg's desk, his phone (bars 2-3)
beats.caption: A post pops on Gerg's phone. He hearts it; the plate lands after the read. Rima's hand un-hearts it.

onscreen.text: POST: NOLE: “CHATGTP is scary good. We are not far from dangerously strong AI.”

cues: music: MM-16 thins to bass + brushes under the post

beats.frame: INSERT · the last wheel
beats.caption: Its last wheel clicks over and settles, legible for the first time: 1,000,000.

beats.frame: INSERT · cut up: Gerg's thumbs, a post composer
beats.caption: The same angle on Gerg's desk: his thumbs post the number.

onscreen.text: POST: GERG: “CHATGTP just crossed 1 million users; it's been 5 days since launch”

cues: on screen only: the post is not voiced (script: posts are pop-ups, never speeches)

beats.frame: HIGH · the hole in the floor, Rima peering down
beats.caption: Rima hands back her launch-night word. Gerg, off: very low.

lines.text: Low-key.
Very low. Basement.

beats.frame: HIGH (held) · the tile, the red glow, the second odometer (phrase 4)
beats.caption: A tile pops up by his desk. Far down it glows red; a $ odometer spins faster. The racks go red-hot.
cues: music: MM-16 settles to a bass pedal under the heat shimmer
palette: the racks step green → amber → red, one a bar

beats.frame: MCU·PF · Mas looking down the hole
beats.caption: Something moves on his face for the first time: one tear. Rima reads it as sentiment; he corrects her.

lines.text: A million people, Mas. You're actually crying for them.
it's the bill.
mostly the bill.

beats.frame: HIGH · the tear falls to the GPU
beats.caption: The tear lands on a red-hot GPU. Tssss. At the edge, his phone lights red; a siren's whine.
cues: sfx: tssss, steam in three held puffs · the phone's siren J-cuts in under the last puff

beats.caption: Reviewer slate: 2 / 3 · NOON, LAS VEGAS
cues: reviewer-only slate between excerpts (not part of the show)

beats.frame: WIDE · establishing
beats.caption: The suite over the Strip. A crane truck grinds past; every glass shivers except his. Race-weekend banners on the Strip below; practice-lap engines far off.
cues: music: temp MM-07 BLUEPRINT waltz (mm07 underscore) · thins + ducks ~-10 dB under talk · tape-stop on JOIN

beats.frame: INSERT · hand, glass, laptop
beats.caption: He nudges the glass true. On the laptop: BOARD · VIDEO CALL · JOIN. The glow turns to blueprint.

beats.frame: GFX · THE SHEET
beats.caption: Her blueprint figure reads the board's plan. Three chairs walk off; a ring draws round the four.

lines.text: Three of us stepped down this year.
Leave out Mas and Gerg, and the four of us are a majority.
This board controls the company. Not the other way round.

onscreen.text: ALYI · NELEH · MADA · THE QUIET VOTE

seq.place: THE PLAN: the blueprint behind the button

beats.frame: GFX · detail: THE ZEROS
beats.caption: The investor's key ring gets VOTES: 0; the CEO box gets EQUITY: 0. The two zeros hold side by side.

lines.text: Our biggest investor has put in billions. It gets this many votes.
And the CEO? What does he own?
Good question.

beats.frame: GFX · the path and the break
beats.caption: The four step onto a numbered path; step 1 is NOON · VIDEO CALL. The fold curls; the sheet tears.

beats.frame: INSERT · trackpad, JOIN
beats.caption: His finger over JOIN while he thinks it through. Then the click; the waltz tape-stops on it.

lines.text: alyi set it up. probably just the budget.

beats.frame: POV · the call grid (his laptop)
beats.caption: His side: no words reach us. Alyi's tile takes the speaking ring; a dialog pops over Mas's tile.

seq.place: the board call, on his laptop

cues: music: temp MM-08 LEVERAGE low (mm08 underscore) · hard stop on the Cancel click

beats.frame: SINGLE · ECU his eyes
beats.caption: His pupils move one pixel toward the dialog. Nothing else moves.

beats.frame: POV · the call grid
beats.caption: An arrow tagged ALYI / CO-FOUNDER steps onto Cancel and clicks. Silence. His tile falls out.

onscreen.text: You've been removed from the meeting.

cues: sound: the one deliberate silence (Cancel click -> phone buzz): music and room out, room tone only

beats.frame: SINGLE · CU Mas, still
beats.caption: Mas, full frame, the one-pixel smile. Nothing changes.

beats.frame: INSERT · his phone
beats.caption: The phone buzzes and the room comes back. Suggested replies; his thumb takes the middle one.
cues: sound: the suite comes back on the buzz · no score under "super."

beats.frame: OTS · over Mas onto the laptop
beats.caption: "super." into the laptop. The four tiles freeze on the word. The room falls away to night.

lines.text: super.

beats.frame: INSERT · the desk, the carve
beats.caption: With the pen he pocketed from the MACROSOFT check, he carves a third mark beside two faint ones.

lines.text: i don't keep score.

cues: music: temp MM-08 26A felt (mm08 underscore) · thins under the V.O.

beats.frame: INSERT · the three marks, from above
beats.caption: The Orb's eye-light steps onto mark 1. The Orb is counting.

beats.frame: FLASH · F1.2 TPOOL
beats.caption: A render front out of mark 1: a frosted boardroom door, two shadows leaning together.

onscreen.text: RAIL: TPOOL, HIS FIRST COMPANY · TWO STAFF REVOLTS

beats.frame: INSERT · the marks
beats.caption: The light steps to mark 2, then 3, and stops on his thumb.

beats.frame: SINGLE · the Orb's iris
beats.caption: The iris lifts to his face. Toast: rewinding… A whip right to left into pass one.
Reviewer slate: 3 / 3 · 2 AM
cues: reviewer-only slate between excerpts (not part of the show)

beats.frame: INSERT · the home shot: glass and lanyard
beats.caption: The glass, its water line one flat row, and the GUEST lanyard laid square beside it.

seq.place: his dark room (Gerg on the monitor)

cues: music: temp DARK ROOM pedal + pulse (v4 S5 render, looped) · ducks under talk

beats.frame: INSERT · his phone and thumb
beats.caption: Rima's post, then the same words from everyone. He hearts every one on the beat.

lines.text: four hundred and six. four hundred and seven. four hundred and six.

onscreen.text: RIMA: “NopeAI is nothing without its people”

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · Mas and the Orb
beats.caption: The Orb's iris steps off the phone onto the lanyard. He answers the look.

lines.text: the badge was a joke.

beats.frame: SINGLE · MCU Mas
beats.caption: The Orb does not look away. The one true word. Rack to the Orb.

lines.text: mostly.

beats.frame: OTS · over Mas onto the monitor, Gerg's tile big
beats.caption: The staff letter is already open. Gerg's tile rings; Mas clicks it. Gerg is typing, 2 AM.

lines.text: Sorry, one sec. I've got a build compiling.
it's two in the morning, gerg.
Best time there is. Nobody else is pushing anything. Anyway, that's not why I called. You've got the staff letter open? Scroll down.
gerg. he'll say he's compiling.

beats.frame: POV · his monitor: the letter, one page, a slow scroll
beats.caption: Gerg reads the letter as each line scrolls up; the count rolls to 745. The scroll stops on ALYI.

lines.text: They're telling the board they're "…unable to work for or with people that lack competence, judgment and care for our mission and employees."
And they'll quit, "…unless all current board members resign…"
and go to macrosoft.
Yep. Macrosoft's promised them "…positions for all NopeAI employees…"
that's a lot of desks.
Scroll to the bottom.
Alyi signed it.

onscreen.text: “…unable to work for or with people that lack competence, judgment and care for our mission and employees.”

beats.frame: SINGLE · MCU Mas, the monitor's light
beats.caption: "alyi voted." / "He did both." Hold on Mas a beat: the pause is his.

lines.text: alyi voted.
He did both.

beats.frame: INSERT · the check
beats.caption: A check slides out of the rack's slot. Gerg explains it; then the stamp: VOID IF CEO MISSING.

lines.text: That'll be the share sale. Everybody's been waiting on that one.

beats.frame: OTS · back over Mas onto the monitor
beats.caption: "what are you building?" Gerg, still typing, sunny. His keys stop after "case".

lines.text: what are you building?
The company. Again. Just in case.
gerg never waits to be asked.

beats.frame: POV · cut-in: Gerg's tile fills the monitor
beats.caption: His one look up, at Mas. The Build and his keys stop; the pedal holds. Then he types again.

lines.text: So. Do I tell everyone to pack?
ask me when it compiles.

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · the back wall; the slate door rises
beats.caption: A slate-blue door steps up out of the shadow, Tasya's sign taped to it. A key turns. His voice.

lines.text: Don't get up, Mas. I won't keep you. Everyone is welcome.
everyone.
Yes. You first. And there's a desk for every one of them.

beats.frame: SINGLE · MCU Mas, the door soft behind
beats.caption: After a full offer, and a pause that belongs to the door. Rack to the door, open a crack.

lines.text: leave it open.
